data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=3MQJ9Axm59MQ7kNvgHK1lgw&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAOr68b3aoUcYsNHkMToyBDfZTH5wGGZpY24Q7w8Q1iNQ&oe=6752E09C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=jnoVsqTYqY8Q7kNvgGjTZDm&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDiuuPthrfZSa2jhBglI6tqR0J63cmfL_JaC23r0NvLPg&oe=6752EA24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=sGkc-mIwWqoQ7kNvgGD2hP9&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCFJaufB7UuQwfXCq58aEOIs63LrXsDrKmoW7wgSpFIUA&oe=6752D187)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2Q_UruKwwxAQ7kNvgF2MRAB&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB-jdSxtkC_UiK6bzk28Tg4hAKb_kl7pwMLoF2PxqD1KQ&oe=6752C466)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d6cXMZePeWMQ7kNvgGMCL3k&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCuFR9ngGZDF9d4_kbfq572XaAUaam8uytH-F4Iimw2cA&oe=6752F0D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iHFZhBKlGvsQ7kNvgEEpj3U&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAof8TCLZuBtR1WTtovccsgi0Jtoq-pOCWJ_uyIfISBZw&oe=6752ED59)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=8Kq-_zxNj4cQ7kNvgE0Xupd&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD7uaFYLkN-pyyqS_GgDShRUNhFas3JE1Wogl6IByymBw&oe=6752D370)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=laXJlHpUIdMQ7kNvgG_T5aS&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDqd9_ReAT3PEkBe-eb92OuV4j6om6BFCMHcX-rYbcOIg&oe=6752F62A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Im89b6Curx4Q7kNvgGGSFxt&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCI-VLBmZFuMhfYNc1s-xbET8Ua9aMWlpK_GOKtgq9YSw&oe=6752D197)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ppGD3C4nOzoQ7kNvgFRPJtG&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCrZUWLzeSeadn3QiepvoZu1K4V_Ns0fiS32x723SB5BA&oe=6752ED0C)
